ask: mkae a list of who paid and who still owes
sentence: Shows a shared list of who has paid a fixed per-spot price for an event and who still owes, with the amount left to collect, where each person marks their own spots paid.
use_when: Collecting payment from a group for event tickets or a cover charge
Tracking who has sent money and who still owes
Some people are paying for more than one spot
Everyone should be able to mark themselves paid
dont_use_when: Splitting a bill with different amounts per person
Keeping a running balance of debts over time between friends
Voting or picking a date or option
